## Malta Memorial (Floriana)
Located in Floriana, Malta, this is likely the most prominent Malta Memorial. It commemorates the casualties of both World Wars, particularly those with no known grave. The memorial was designed by Sir Hubert Worthington and was unveiled in 1954.

## Malta Memorial at Arlington National Cemetery
There's a Malta Memorial in Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia, USA, which honors the relationship between Malta and the United States.

## Various WWII Memorials in Malta
Malta has numerous memorials related to World War II, given the island's crucial role during the war and the heavy bombing it endured during the Siege of Malta (1940-1942).

## Commonwealth War Graves Commission Memorials
There are several Commonwealth War Graves Commission memorials in Malta commemorating various military units and casualties.
